title: Resolve canonical paths and promote local proof before action
purpose: Default precondition for repository-backed local actions. Resolve the machine/profile path owner, refresh remote truth, preserve existing work, and promote remote, development-checkout, production/use-path, and real-entrypoint proof independently.
triggers: before invoking a repository-owned validator, build, generator, launcher, updater, or deployment helper
before handing an operator a repository-owned local command
newly merged command must run locally
canonical path, checkout, worktree, production path, or local adoption is in question
inputs: required integration SHA or content floor when the action depends on a particular change
steps: Load tooling/harness/operational/canonical-path.contract.json and resolve the selected machine/profile owner; do not choose a directory from model preference.
Classify whether this action is a provider-only remote read/static inspection exemption. If exempt, record the exact exemption and stop path promotion before making any local-adoption claim.
Resolve developmentCheckout, productionUsePath, temporaryWorktreeRoot, and realOperatorEntrypoint from the canonical owner. A role may be N/A only when the owner records a role-specific reason.
Refresh remote truth with git fetch --all --prune --tags and resolve the actual remote default branch; do not assume main.
If an integration/content SHA is required, prove remote-main-contains-sha with git merge-base --is-ancestor against the refreshed remote default head.
Inspect the canonical development checkout branch, HEAD, tracking relation, ahead/behind counts, origin, and git status --short before mutation.

If the canonical development checkout is clean, on the default branch, and behind-only, update it with git pull --ff-only. If dirty, diverged, separately owned, or on unique work, preserve it unchanged and use an approved isolated worktree under temporaryWorktreeRoot for the bounded proof/action.
Prove canonical-development-checkout-current only from the checkout actually inspected after refresh. A remote SHA is insufficient.

Prove production-use-path-current separately by resolving and inspecting productionUsePath. When it equals developmentCheckout, record same-path and reuse the observed SHA/content proof; otherwise prove the production/use surface independently or leave this state unproved.
Resolve the realOperatorEntrypoint from tracked path/profile authority and prove it is tracked/present at the production/use path before invocation. Do not guess a launcher filename.

Run the owning validator/build/generator/launcher only after its required path states are proven. Mark real-entrypoint-observes-it only after actual bounded invocation/receipt; propagate every nonzero exit.
Record each proof state as PROVEN, UNPROVEN, or NOT_APPLICABLE with evidence. Never promote one state merely because a lower state passed.
forbidden: inventing a second mutable clone as the canonical checkout
treating an arbitrary Desktop, OneDrive, backup, or current-working-directory clone as authority
claiming remote main containment proves the canonical development checkout is current
claiming a current development checkout proves a separate production/use path is current
claiming file presence proves the real operator entrypoint observed the change
deleting noncanonical or dirty work to make the path look clean
outputs: resolved canonical role bindings or explicit N/A reasons
remote default branch and required SHA containment result
real operator entrypoint identity and observed receipt when invoked
proofCeiling: Only the proof states actually observed during this workflow. Repository/provider proof never silently upgrades workstation, production/use-path, entrypoint, runtime, deployment, provider, or acceptance proof.
